name: ApartmentScout
description: Agent-ready apartment research for any city: rank listings on your own criteria and true monthly cost, map door-to-door commutes, audit prices, read building records, and see each unit's light, view and your furniture in 3D.

paragraphs: Rank every listing on your own criteria and its true monthly cost, time the commute, read the building's records, and stand inside the exact unit, with your own furniture, in the real city around it.
Map, noise, plain-words search and the trade-off pad, then inside the unit, the report and move plan, a phone at the tour, and the day turning to night. Watch it in full quality (MP4).

ApartmentScout came out of a real search for a one-bedroom in Manhattan: 738 listings in 260 buildings, and the same questions for every finalist. What does it cost a month once fees and free months are counted? How long is the trip door to door? What do the city's records say about the building? How loud is the street, and will the window see the sky or a wall? This repository turns that process into agent playbooks, a Python command line and a dashboard you own, for any city, with that search included as a worked example.
features: The main things it does: rank homes on a commute map, stand inside the exact unit, see its sun and its city, check the building, and compare finalists.

The map, the ranked list and commute times, with a home open Inside the exact unit: your own furniture, paintings and the view The real city around it, at dusk The same window at the same moment: floor 8 in shadow,…
